scientific_integrity: Proof reconstructs all twelve edge crossings. Exact rational finite verification supplements but does not replace the analytic argument. Originality is provisional under historical-priority risk.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-normal, uniform-intersecting-offset sections of nondegenerate three-dimensional parallelotopes only. No recovery of projection signs, Euclidean side lengths, or source-body metric shape. Historical-priority comparison for Chakerian and Logothetti (1991) remains incomplete; no independent audit.
title: The complete uniform-offset section law and its inverse phase boundary for parallelotopes
